title: UK DMO pilot switch auction — a GEMM familiarisation TEST only; no gilts transferred, issued or cancelled, and no time announced
source: EST: TWO independent UK Debt Management Office primaries, both fetched direct 2026-09-15 and text-extracted locally. (1) dmo.gov.uk/media/xxdl4wzy/pr290526.pdf — the Q2 2026-27 gilt operations calendar announcement of 29 May 2026 (HTTP 200, 213,519 bytes), whose section 4 'Planned switch auctions' reads verbatim: 'The DMO will be scheduling a pilot switch auction on 24 September 2026. Feedback nearer the time will determine the source and destination gilts.' (2) dmo.gov.uk/media/ddejgfzz/pr170726.pdf — press notice of 17 July 2026 (HTTP 200, 161,613 bytes), under 'Planned test switch auction on Thursday 24 September 2026': 'the pilot switch auction planned for Thursday 24 September 2026 will take place as a test to be conducted with the Gilt-edged Market Makers (GEMMs). This will enable the GEMMs to familiarise themselves with the bidding and allocation processes. No gilts will be transferred, issued or cancelled as part of this test. Further details of the arrangements for the test will be shared with the GEMMs closer to the date of the test.' The July notice DE-SCOPES the May one: on 29 May the DMO expected source and destination gilts; by 17 July there are none. NO TIME IS PUBLISHED for the test by either notice. Stays estimate on one mechanical count, not on date doubt: the confirmed-prefix taxonomy in market-events-data.ts (IR:/CAL:/BLS:/FED:/PJM:/SEC:/TSY:/OCC:/BEA:/CENSUS:/ISM:/CB:/UMICH:/FHFA:) has no slot for a non-US sovereign debt office, the same limit jgb-20y-auction-2026-09-15, ecb-decision-2026-09-10 and boj-decision-2026-09-18 all recorded; and this lane may not self-confirm. Every dmo.gov.uk HTML page (homepage, /calendars/, /publications/press-notices/, /data/pdfdatareport) 302s into a ShieldSquare/perfdrive bot-validation interstitial from both curl and the fetch tool — only direct /media/*.pdf paths resolve, so this rests on PDFs whose slugs were already known. Recorded in the ledger's probe-ref.blocked. Checked 2026-09-15
notes: CANONICAL FILE WRITTEN BY THE never-assessed INITIAL RESEARCH 2026-09-15, superseding proposals/dmo-pilot-switch-auction-test-2026-09-24.from-boe-decision-2026-09-17.json (the BoE lane's D-2 sweep discovery, read in full first per docs/process/EVENT-RESEARCH.md). THE PROPOSAL'S CORE FINDING STANDS AND IS KEPT: 24 September is a GEMM familiarisation test, not the long-gilt absorption mechanism the BoE ledger's leg 5 coverage hinted at, and 'No gilts will be transferred, issued or cancelled.' WHAT THE INITIAL RESEARCH ADDED, from three further primaries: (a) the 29 May 2026 Q2 calendar is a SECOND DMO primary for the date and shows the operation was DE-SCOPED between May and July — 'Feedback nearer the time will determine the source and destination gilts' became a test with no gilts at all; (b) the CURRENT rulebook, Official Operations in the Gilt Market: An Operational Notice, 1 April 2026 (dmo.gov.uk/media/1grjjk40/opnot010426.pdf), carries only two sentences on switch auctions and paragraph 54 defers the mechanics — 'Plans to use these and the details of how such auctions would operate are likely to be set out in or in conjunction with the annual issuance plan, any update or other notice' — so THE MECHANICS OF A 2026 UK SWITCH AUCTION ARE UNPUBLISHED, which is why a test exists at all; (c) the APF-absorption story is refuted on the DMO's own arithmetic, not just on the no-transfer sentence — the Debt Management Report 2026-27 Table 3.A budgets gilt secondary market purchases of NIL in 2026-27 (2025-26: GBP 0.1bn), and its remit paragraph 3.22 states the purpose as 'promote liquidity in certain gilts, including at benchmark maturities'. NO PRICE CHANNEL IS CLAIMED: symbols: [], impact low, and 0 hits for gilt/DMO/sterling/GBP/UK across trade-playbooks.md and multi-symbol-sweep.md, re-grepped this session. Estimate widens caution only; it licenses no date-keyed action. THE STANDING JOB OF THIS ENTRY IS AN ATTRIBUTION GUARD, and it is live: the most recent coverage found (cryptobriefing.com, dated 2026-09-07, i.e. seven weeks AFTER the de-scoping notice) still describes 24 September as a pilot switch auction that would 'retire long-dated bonds and replace them with shorter maturities'. It moves no stock.
